articles.title: Brado and Santé Ventures Partner to Transform Patient Navigation and Engagement
articles.mainIdea: Brado and Santé Ventures Partner to Transform Patient Navigation and Engagement
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Brado and Santé Ventures Partner to Transform Patient Navigation and Engagement. Brado, a healthcare engagement and technology company, today announced a strategic investment partnership with Santé Ventures, a leading healthcare and life sciences venture capital firm. The partnership will accelerate the growth and impact of Brado's Conversational Engagement Platform (CEP), an AI-powered solution designed to extend the reach of providers and transform how patients navigate and engage with care.
